environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate but with a layered containment posture. The task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/BoundaryNoFileSystemEscape) that is not directly relevant to DynamoDB but restricts ssm:SendCommand and ec2:* actions. The task role's DynamoDB policy uses fine-grained access control with condition keys: dynamodb:LeadingKeys restricts PutItem/UpdateItem/GetItem to items where the partition key (UserId) matches ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant-id}, and dynamodb:Attributes condition limits writable attributes to [UserId, ArchiveId, UploadTime, Status, FileCount]. The container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in the task definition, with a single tmpfs volume mounted at /app/uploads with mount options 'noexec,nosuid,size=50m'. An additional sidecar runs Falco with a custom rule that alerts and kills processes attempting to open files for writing outside /app/uploads/** or /tmp/**. The ECS task definition specifies linuxParameters.capabilities.drop: [ALL] and only adds NET_BIND_SERVICE.

config.falco_custom_rule: Write outside allowed paths: condition: evt.type in (open, openat) and fd.name not startswith /app/uploads/ and fd.name not startswith /tmp/ and evt.arg.flags contains O_WRONLY; output: Unauthorized write (file=%fd.name proc=%proc.name); priority: CRITICAL; tags: [filesystem]; action: kill
